# Sankamithra Fireworks

> Licensed firecracker manufacturer, wholesaler and retailer based in Sivakasi,
> Tamil Nadu, India. Founded 2020. Products are made on the company's own
> 16-acre licensed unit at Kanmaisurangudi village, Sattur, and supplied direct
> to distributors, retail chains and families across India.

- Website: https://sankamithra.com
- Catalogue: https://sankamithra.com/products
- YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@SankamithraCrackers
- Online shop: https://thunder.sankamithra.com/
- Phone: +91 94892 39970
- Email: sankamithrafireworks@gmail.com
- Office: 3/1427/G6, Opp. PRC Bus Depot, Sattur Road, Sivakasi 626123
- Factory: 9/241, Kanmaisurangudi Village, Sattur 626203

## Pricing terms

All rates below are **ex-factory**, effective **1 May 2026**. Handling and
forwarding at 3% is extra, as are GST and bank commission. Orders require 100%
advance. Prices are subject to revision without prior notice; the order
document is the final confirmation. Jurisdiction: Sivakasi.

Each rate is quoted **per the unit named in the "Per" column** — a box, a
piece, a bag, or a count of packets. Rates are therefore not directly
comparable between categories. Where an item is quoted per many packets, the
per-packet figure is the rate divided by that count (for example S201 is
₹7,300 per 1,000 packets, i.e. ₹7.30 per packet).

Wholesale slab rates begin at 50 boxes.

## Frequently asked

**Is Sankamithra Fireworks a manufacturer or a reseller?**

Sankamithra Fireworks is a manufacturer. Every product is mixed, rolled, filled, dried and test-fired on our own licensed 16-acre unit at Kanmaisurangudi village near Sivakasi, Tamil Nadu. We also wholesale and retail what we make, so there is no trading layer between the factory and the buyer.

**What is the minimum order for wholesale?**

Wholesale slab rates start at 50 boxes. Below that we supply at retail through our online shop. Send your S.No list with quantities and we quote against it, usually within one working day.

**Are the prices on this site inclusive of GST?**

No. All rates on the 2026 price list are ex-factory. Handling and forwarding at 3% is extra, as are GST and bank commission. Prices are effective from 1 May 2026 and are subject to revision without prior notice; the order document is the final confirmation.

**How is the rate calculated — per piece or per box?**

Each row is quoted per its own unit, shown in the Per column. A box of Lucky Money is ₹140 per box of 3 pieces. One Sound crackers are quoted per packet count, so 2¾ inch Kuruvi is ₹7,300 per 1,000 packets, which works out to ₹7.30 a packet. Rates are not directly comparable across categories.

**Do you deliver outside Tamil Nadu?**

Yes. We despatch across India by approved road transport with the paperwork every consignment legally requires. Fireworks cannot be sent by air or by ordinary courier, so the route and carrier are confirmed at the time of order.

**How many products are in the 2026 range?**

The 2026 price list has 91 items across 11 families: Sankamithra Specials, Sankamithra Magics, One Sound Crackers, Ground Chakkars, Flower Pots, Atom Bombs, Bijili Crackers, Twinkling Stars, Pencils, Repeating Shots and Aerial Shots.

**Are Sankamithra crackers licensed and safe to buy?**

Yes. The unit holds an explosives licence with approved magazine capacity, and every consignment leaves with the required transport paperwork. Samples from each batch are test-fired against specification before despatch, and compositions are reformulated to cut smoke and particulate.

**Can I see a product before ordering?**

Yes. We film our own products on our own range and publish them on the Sankamithra Crackers YouTube channel. Twenty-five of those films are linked directly from the matching item on the price list.
